method: Terms second read: re-read the 'Security Deposit' and 'Early Termination Charge' boxes of each current EMA fact sheet (downloaded again 2 Nov from the links on savewithtuas.com/our-electricity-plans) and wrote the wording independently. Other official sources checked: the Standard and Non-Standard Conditions of Supply (v190626) confirm the S$200 early termination charge (clause 3.3) but do not state the deposit percentage; the residential FAQ (savewithtuas.com/faq) only says SP Group may ask for a deposit top-up. No other official page states the 65%, so the fact sheet is the only source for it.

sources.what: Conditions of Supply clause 3.3: early termination charges of S$200 (GST is not applicable)

plans.name: PowerFIX 24

terms.deposit_source: Security Deposit (see footnote 7): Security Deposit (“SD”) shall be collected and retained on behalf of Retailer by SP Services Limited (“SP”). Existing SP’s customers will not be required to provide additional SD. Non-existing SP’s customers will be required to provide a SD equivalent to 65% of the SD as determined and published by SP.
terms.deposit: Collected by SP Services, not Tuas Power. If you already have an SP Services account you pay nothing more; new SP Services customers pay 65% of SP's published deposit.
